findings.current: Buried beneath the pounding hooves and rushing wind, that faint ripple carried a voice I had never heard before.
findings.defect: The source says the ripple came through many noises, both large and small. This limits the surrounding noise to the hoofbeats and wind, dropping the explicit range of sounds.
findings.rationale: The Korean specifies 크고 작은 여러 소음, meaning various noises large and small; the current line names only the hoofbeats and wind.
findings.replacement: Buried beneath the many noises, loud and soft, that faint ripple carried a voice I had never heard before.

summary: The assembled chapter is faithful overall. One minor sound-detail omission remains.
